steps.text: Two pints gives you another cloak.

steps.npc: They call me Two pints... I'm the taskmaster for the Ardougne Achievement Diary.

options.text: Why do they call you Two pints?

steps.player: Why do they call you Two pints?

steps.npc: I'm not too sure really... my memory isn't the greatest... *hic*

steps.player: Maybe you lost a game of Runelink and had to change your name as a forfeit?

steps.npc: Perhaps... *hic* I know a great drinking game for that!

steps.text: Two pints mutters incoherently and stumbles away.

steps.npc: It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In and around Ardougne it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.

options.text: I have a question about my Achievement Diary

steps.player: I have a question about my Achievement diary.

steps.npc: Well, there are four different Ardougne cloaks, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
know more about?

steps.player: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!

steps.npc: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Ardougne: The Citizen in West Ardougne will buy cats for 200 death runes each, some drops in the Tower of Life will be noted and the cape can teleport you to the Monastery
south of Ardougne too.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy rewards: Wizard Cromperty will give you 100 noted pure essence each day, even more drops will be noted in the Tower of Life, you've got a 10% better chance at pickpocketing in Ardougne, you
can toggle the ring of life to teleport to Ardougne, you get three teleports each day to the Ardougne farming patch and you can hold up to 56 coin pouches whilst pickpocketing.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy and medium benefits: Wizard Cromperty will give you 150 pure essence each day, you can toggle the Watchtower teleport to the centre of Yanille, claim further drops as notes in the Tower of
Life, teleports to the farming patch increased to five per day, have a 10% better chance at pickpocketing everywhere and you can hold up to 84 coin pouches whilst pickpocketing.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards: Wizard Cromperty will give you 250 pure essence every day, you will catch 50% more fish from the Fishing Trawler and receive 25% more marks of grace on the

Ardougne agility course. Your cape will have unlimited teleports to the Ardougne farming patch, Bert will automatically deliver your daily sand and you can hold up to 140 coin pouches whilst pickpocketing.

options.text: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.player: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.npc: Just complete the tasks in Ardougne so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
See you later!
